title: Invalid Campaign Member Specificity
notes: Every way a specificity can say nothing or say the impossible, one member each. A character may be anything an author could have made a class and nothing they could not, so the bounds each delta is measured against are the class's own field's, over the line the member's unit type reaches through its class.

roster.name: Stated To Be Someone
roster.notes: Claims a character is specific and never says how.

roster.name: Luckless By Nought
roster.notes: An author who wrote a number meant to change something; leaving the stat out is how a member says nothing about it.

roster.name: Felled Before The First Blow
roster.notes: Twelve health taken from twelve: a character who is already dead is not a character a class could have been.

roster.name: Faster Than The Field
roster.notes: Above the ceiling the class's own movement is held to.

roster.name: Rooted Where He Stands
roster.notes: Movement at nought, which no class may be authored with either.

roster.name: Nobody's Shape
roster.notes: No unit type, so no line to measure a delta against: the unresolved reference is reported and the delta is not, because a bad reference must never reach an author as a bad delta.

recruits.name: Slower Than Standing Still
recruits.notes: A recruit is held to every rule a founding member is. The archer never mentions speed, so the delta lands on the one the stat block gives a line that omits it, and takes it to nought.
